notes.title: December Update & Charity Event Ongoing!
notes.content:
Winter is here and Christmas is approaching fast, so we're happy to announce that we'll be donating half of the Steam sales for December to [url=http://www.gamesaid.org/]GamesAid[/url], who help disadvantaged and disabled children and young people.

Moreover, players who update to the latest version of KEL will notice that it's been snowing in the game and the village is preparing for the Winter Holidays ;)

So we hope you'll enjoy the 'frosty' new feel of Kel the Skeleton and help us raise funds for the GamesAid charity!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=359319650]http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=359319650[/url]

notes.title: November Update and Upcoming Charity Event
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that thanks to some amazingly helpful players, we've made more progress with our game for the November update.

There are changes to the mechanism for converting villagers, as well as a different reaction from them if you kill the Hermit on your own. There's also a series of minor bug fixes, however many of the changes will probably not take effect if you use a saved game instead of starting a new one.

In addition, we're preparing to participate with KEL in a Christmas charity event. All the sales from the game will go to charity. We'll post more updates as soon as the details are decided upon.

So we're expecting a slight chill in the game as winter settles in and KEL gets ready to take Santa's place ;)
